title: Probably Up to Date — The Scholars' Coast
description: Probabilistically Bounded Staleness told on the scholars' coast of Paxos: a work kept at three libraries, a writer who waits for some of them, a reader who asks a few, and the odds that the copy handed over is the newest.
question: When a store reads from only some of its copies, how likely is an answer to be out of date, and by how much? Can we promise that it is probably not?
how: We find out by exploring how ancient Greek libraries, each consulting only a few of the others, judged how likely a copy was to be out of date.

papers.authors: Peter Bailis, Shivaram Venkataraman, Michael J. Franklin, Joseph M. Hellerstein and Ion Stoica
papers.title: Probabilistically Bounded Staleness for Practical Partial Quorums
